## Pensieve 0.5.0

> *"I use the Pensieve. One simply siphons the excess thoughts from one's mind, pours them into the basin, and examines them at one's leisure."*
> — Albus Dumbledore, *Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire*

The AI research notebook that keeps up with you: think out loud and get organized, read papers in your own language, never miss new work, and plan a day you can actually do — on your computer and your phone.

**Free · Works locally · Collects no data · No account.** Your notes live on your own computer; every paired device keeps a full copy that works offline. No Pensieve cloud, no analytics, no tracking. AI requests go straight to the AI service you choose, with your own key.

### Download

| Your system | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10 / 11 | **Pensieve-Setup-0.5.0.exe** |
| Mac with Apple Silicon (M1–M4) | **Pensieve-0.5.0-mac-arm64.zip** |
| Mac with Intel | **Pensieve-0.5.0-mac-x64.zip** |
| Linux (64-bit) | **Pensieve-0.5.0-linux-x86_64.AppImage** or **Pensieve-0.5.0-linux-amd64.deb** |
| Android 8+ (HarmonyOS via 卓易通) | **Pensieve-0.5.0-android.apk** |
| iPhone / iPad (iOS 15+) | **Pensieve-0.5.0-ios-unsigned.ipa** — install with Sideloadly or AltStore ([how](https://photonghost308.github.io/pensieve-app/#ios-install)) |

Install it first on the computer you keep running — it is the hub your phone syncs with. Then add an AI model key (Settings → AI models) and pair your phone (Settings → Sync → Pair a phone). Tour and guide: **[photonghost308.github.io/pensieve-app](https://photonghost308.github.io/pensieve-app/)**

First start: Windows SmartScreen → *More info → Run anyway*. macOS → *System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway* (not notarized yet). Linux → `chmod +x` the AppImage, or `sudo apt install ./Pensieve-0.5.0-linux-amd64.deb`.

### iPhone and iPad

**Pensieve-0.5.0-ios-unsigned.ipa** is an unsigned arm64 device build for iOS / iPadOS 15+. Use Sideloadly or AltStore on a computer to sign it with your own Apple ID and install it — Safari cannot install the IPA directly. Free Apple ID signing normally needs refreshing every seven days. This is not an App Store or TestFlight release. See the [installation instructions / 中文安装步骤](https://photonghost308.github.io/pensieve-app/#ios-install).

iPhone / iPad 安装包（iOS 15 及以上）：下载 IPA，通过电脑上的 Sideloadly 或 AltStore 自签安装，不能直接在手机浏览器点击安装。免费 Apple ID 通常每 7 天需刷新签名。录音时保持应用在前台。本版尚未经过实体 iPhone 测试。

The device and simulator builds are checked by GitHub Actions; testing on a physical iPhone is still to come. The simulator ZIP (**Pensieve-0.5.0-ios-simulator.zip**) is for Xcode developers only and cannot be installed on an iPhone.

### What's in it
- 🎙 **Think out loud, get organized** — with the cursor in a note, your words are tidied and typed there; with no cursor, they become an idea, to-dos and calendar entries. *Fix a name* corrects a misheard name everywhere and remembers it.
- 📄 **Read papers in your language** — translations follow the paper's paragraphs with the key sentences in **bold**; original abstracts translated with one click; the reader remembers where you were.
- 🔎 **Never miss new work** — AI searches arXiv and OpenAlex, rates each paper against your project, and a daily push brings the newest ones (dated, never twice).
- 🗓 **Plan around what is fixed** — calendar, main line of the day, deadlines, and reminders that reach your phone.
- 📬 **Email that tells you what it needs**, 📝 **pages with AI conversations**, **Notion and Obsidian import**, **Zotero / EndNote** libraries, 💻 **Codex, Git and terminals** on the desktop.

### New in 0.5.0
- **Update checks work behind a VPN or campus network.** GitHub answers only 60 update checks an hour per internet address; behind a shared VPN or a university network others use that up, and Pensieve said *Could not check: GitHub: HTTP 403*. Now, when GitHub refuses, Pensieve reads the release from its website instead, and failing that from github.com itself — downloads are still checked against the release's checksums. Tested with a real update: Pensieve 0.4.9, installed on Windows, found this version, downloaded and checked it, installed it over itself, and opened again as 0.5.0 with all its notes.
- **Updates never cost your phone's data.** Every Pensieve APK is signed with the same key — Android installs an update only over an app with the same signature, and otherwise offers only to uninstall first, which would erase the phone's notes. Pensieve now checks the signature of a downloaded update before handing it to Android: one signed differently is refused and deleted, never installed, and Pensieve says why. Tested on Android 14: 0.4.9 → 0.5.0 through Pensieve's own *Install* (Android's "Update this app?" dialog) keeps everything; a differently signed APK is refused. *If Android ever tells you the signature is different, don't uninstall — download the APK from this page (builds from elsewhere, such as test builds, are signed differently).*
- **Settings → Papers & code**: the two paper-library options (translated abstracts, translate a selection right away) show their text again — they appeared as two bare tick boxes.
- *Updating from 0.4.9: if the 0.4.9 on your computer keeps saying HTTP 403, check again later (GitHub's limit resets within the hour) or install this version by hand once; from 0.5.0 on, the check no longer depends on that limit.*

### New in 0.4.9
- Import your **timetable** (photo, PDF, Excel, Word, .ics) with exact times, classrooms and exams; **paper-reader highlights** that cover exactly the text, with ⌘Z undo and colour changes; **Pensieve updates itself**; the **idea library by project** with connections across projects; **Zotero / EndNote / Mendeley** import; **Notion and Obsidian** with H4 headings, links to headings and attachments; formulas at the right size; your own **phone bottom bar**.

Checksums: `SHA256SUMS.txt` (desktop and Android) and `ios-SHA256SUMS.txt` (the iOS IPA).

Pensieve is designed by **Tianyi Xu** — [photontec.github.io](https://photontec.github.io/#about-me).
